mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to a boost in the overall economy, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, which can lead to increased borrowing and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate increased consumer spending and a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of high retail sales and low unemployment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply indicate an easing monetary cycle, which can lead to increased borrowing and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods with high inflation are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate and an increase in payroll employment indicate a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and high payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the GDP growth rate indicates a slowing economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).
